article.linkText: Victor Wembanyama scores 29 points in Spurs win over Blazers
article.story: PORTLAND, Ore -- — Victor Wembanyama scored 29 points and led the San Antonio Spurs to a 125-103 blowout win over the Portland Trail Blazers on Saturday night. Devin Vassell added 15 points for the Spurs (8-2) along with 14 each from Stephon Castle and Julian Champagnie, and 13 from Dylan Harper. Deni Avdija led the Blazers (6-3) with 15 points. Scoot Henderson added 13 points, along with 12 from Damian Lillard and 11 from Jrue Holiday off the bench. Yang Hansen had his first career double-double with 12 points and 10 rebounds. Wembanyama’s 29 points came in just 24 minutes, and he took just 13 shots, going 9 of 13 from the field and 3 of 6 from 3-point range. Up next Spurs: At Phoenix on Monday. Trail Blazers: Host back-to-back matchups against Oklahoma City on Tuesday and Wednesday. ------ See AP’s full NBA coverage here
